description: This construction is part of the artist's Gawu series that includes a number of "cloths" made with recycled metals--liquor bottle tops, evaporated milk tins and wire--that were gathered in and around Nsukka, Nigeria, where the artist lives and works. title: File:El Anatsui, Nukae-1 (close-up) (2922765989).jpg
description: The sewn metal sheets and other artworks in the Gawu series can easily be folded and assembled, adding a sense of performance as his works take on new shapes in response to a gallery's space. His metal constructs are also easy to disassemble and transport, reflecting the long-standing concern of art

title: File:Deerstone with A Spiral below the row of heaven-defining dots and a Sun.jpg
description: Very Unusual Deerstone with A Spiral below the row of heaven-defining dots and a Sun. Below the spiral three horses, legs extended, feet to left walking up. The spiral is an extremely rare motif on deerstones and petroglyphs in Mongolia, though a common symbol elsewhere. Moved to the National Histor
author: James Glazier
